posts.author: CrocPirate
posts.body:
Dreams Circle has a biting animation (an animation sprite sheet, not effseeker) for MV, which you can use for MZ.
Here's the link:
https://dreams-circle.itch.io/ac1-quintessence
And if you want to convert the sprite sheet to effseeker, here's a tutorial:
https://forums.rpgmakerweb.com/inde...-sprite-sheets-into-mz-with-effekseer.133170/
